notes.title: 0.2.3 - Last Playtest Update
notes.notes: [p]Before the changelog: This will be the LAST playtest update. [b]The playtest will close in a week. [/b]If you have any achievements which you still want to get or area you want to explore do it now. It will not be playable afterwards and new players will not be able to sign up. Its closing due to playtesting being largely completed and me focusing on a demo of the game - more info on that will come soon. Also, you still have time to get a super special discord role by filling out the feedback form: [url="https://forms.gle/tQf2ZPjt3pLCrpXUA"]https://forms.gle/tQf2ZPjt3pLCrpXUA[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i]( Unrelated to this changelog: The community translation project has started! notes.title: 0.2 - Level 2
notes.notes: [p]Hi hello, its finally time. The 0.2 Update is finally here! It took.. "a bit" longer than I had hoped but still in time before the next devlog. This Update really is BIG and I hope you enjoy it. Along with it, there is also a new trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="BQZcPJSBlcE;rightthumb"][/previewyoutube][p]Like always, this is a [b]PLAYTEST[/b], so please join the [url="https://discord.gg/VYUedn5bWE"]discord[/url] and fill out the new [url="https://forms.gle/qcnZX5hhJHMNtLD1A"]feedback form[/url] for an exclusive role.[/p][p][/p][p]The changelog is very long so here is a quick TL;DR version:[/p][list][*][p]Level 2[/p][/*][*][p]New Achievements & Music[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of Polish[/p][/*][*][p]Movement overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Music overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Optimisation[/p][/*][*][p]Terminal codes dont reset after dying or quitting and continuing a session anymore[/p][/*][*][p][b]PLIMBO[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Now, here is the full changelog:[/p][p][/p][h1]New Content[/h1][list][*][p]Level 2 [/p][/*][*][p]Wallrunning & Moving Platforms[/p][/*][*][p]3 New Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]4 New Music tracks[/p][/*][*][p]1 New Radio Tracks[/p][/*][/list][h1]New Features[/h1][list][*][p]Interactable & Breakable Radios (you can start / stop the music playing)[/p][/*][*][p]Added checkpoint saving UI, overhauled loading UI[/p][/*][*][p]New "checkpoint" system. These "checkpoints" arent really full checkpoints since they dont have a leaderboard, you cannot spawn on them from the level selector and they must always be bound to a parent checkpoint. They are meant to ease up gameplay and make it less frustrating.[/p][/*][*][p]The codes for the computers are now playthrough persistant, meaning that if you die or quit and the continue your session you will get the same codes. They reset when starting a new game or loading a specific checkpoint.[/p][/*][*][p]CCTV cameras (can be broken by player)[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of new secret commandline commands (easter eggs)[/p][/*][*][p]New commandline commands:[/p][list][*][p]showspeed (shows a GUI with a live updating player speed)[/p][/*][*][p]showpos (shows a GUI with a live updating player position and rotation)[/p][/*][*][p]LoadLevelCommand (Load specific level, checkpoint, savepoint)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PLIMBO[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Movement Changes / Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Crouching is less "slidy now[/p][/*][*][p]You can look around when vaulting now[/p][/*][*][p]Added "slow walking" option[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Vaulting [/p][/*][*][p]Jumping and Moving weaker in general, along with a movement rework[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Music/SFX Changes:[/h2][list][*][p]Changed/Updated tracks:[/p][list][*][p]The Megastructure[/p][/*][*][p]Breathing Metal[/p][/*][*][p]Beyond This World[/p][/*][*][p]CrYoPod[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Replaced Decay with Stacks[/p][/*][*][p]Removed 40AA[/p][/*][*][p]5 New random Ambient sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked all old random ambient sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added light buzz[/p][/*][*][p]SFX overhaul for elevator in "The Megastructure"[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of new ambient & drone sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Changed force field sfx[/p][/*][*][p]Changed pitch of all object collisions to be unique to the object[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted sound levels / mastering[/p][/*][*][p]New wind SFX in "The Megastructure.[/p][/*][*][p]Most notes.title: 0.1.8 - Titlecards, Modding & Bugfixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Created a [url=https://github.com/Stefaaan06/Steam-Leaderboard-Moderation]tool[/url] to modify or remove leaderboard entries, fixing previously broken entries.
[*] Added title card for Chapter 1.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added cooldown to zoom functionality.
[*] Removed assembly stripping to enable modding support.
[*] Game no longer uses compression; while total size is increased, future patches will require smaller downloads and offer faster loading times.
[*] Tweaked object collision particle effects.
[*] Added fog to "The Megastructure"
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

notes.title: Mik 0.1.5 - Leaderboards!
notes.notes:
Hi hello and its finally time for a new update with one of the most requested features - Leaderboards! Along with lots of other bugfixes and changes there is finally some new content and replayability!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added Steam leaderboard with in-game leaderboard display, basic anti-cheat, and basic moderation systems.
[list]
[*] Your times on the leaderboard are counted from the start of the level (meaning that you cant just load any checkpoint and set a record from there). You can find the ingame leaderboard display when you click on your name in the main menu, or in the playtest community hub under "Stats".
[/list]
[*]New secrets added in "The Megastructure."
[*]New RevelOS lore-related application: "Long Range Comms Array."
[*]Steam Cloud Sync: settings and progress now synchronized via Steam Cloud.
[/list]

[h1]Changes & Polish[/h1]

[list]
[*]Restart shortcut now takes less time.
[*]Glass shards now disappear for optimization and visual clarity.
[*]New glass bottle shader implemented.
[*]Minor optimizations through dynamic batching and additional adjustments.
[*]Option and progress files now stored in the correct persistent data path.
[*]Slightly increased music volume levels.
[*]Picked-up objects now rotate smoothly with the player.
[*]Picked-up objects no longer jitter.
[*]Implemented a role system (current role: Developer).
[*]The elevator in "Descent?" is now correctly positioned at the bottom when loading from checkpoints.
[*]Collision particle effects now scale based on collision speed.
[*]Removed music from "Descent?".
[*]Music relocated within "Vent Shaft 13."
[*]Added new computer humming sound.
[*]Computers now visually glitch briefly upon strong impact.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Various collision and clipping issues fixed.
[*]Several main menu issues resolved.
[*]Fixed flare not appearing in "Offices?".
[*]Reverb levels now reset correctly in the main menu.
[*]Fixed camera bobbing functionality.
[*]Application should quit properly on all devices now.
[*]Achievement "1_1" now correctly centered.
[*]Fixed occlusion glitches in "Vent Shaft 13."
[*]Lore text in "Containers?" displays correctly.
[*]Note text in "The Megastructure." displays correctly.
[*]Various additional minor bug fixes.

[*][b]Platform-Specific Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Resolved Linux rendering issues by switching from OpenGL to Vulkan.
[/list]
[/list]


Thanks for playing & giving feedback 
- Stefaaan !!
